evidence.quote: It is a unique 4-year program, developed with two prestigious partner universities
The program covers four years of study: the Italian degree is three years long, while the foreign degrees last four years.

English is the common language of the WBB, and students become versed in the language of business in Asia, Europe and North America during extracurricular activities and internships arranged in each country.
The World Bachelor in Business (WBB) is entirely taught in English and jointly designed by Bocconi University

notes: Teaching languages: pages mention Chinese, Italian and a "Second Foreign Language" as subjects/classes within the curriculum; these are course subjects, not programme teaching languages, so only English is listed. Intakes: no dated deadline or start date with day/month/year is given for this programme. ApplicationChannel: no page names Universitaly or a university application portal/form for this programme; the programme page only says "This program has specific application and admissions procedures, as well as dedicated fees, scholarships and accommodation." Tuition: the € 25.000 annual contribution for WBB is from a general fees page (a.a. 2026-27) and is not tied to non-EU/foreign-qualification status; it is also tied to enrollment at Bocconi only, while the programme spans three universities. Included with caution; auditor should verify the amount applying to the Moroccan applicant for the current year. The two 100% Full tuition waivers pages concern Italian-resident students and therefore do not state a fee for this applicant.
